missed_functions.why: The Servo supply temperature line of IOBoard.md states that the trip latches until the operator clear control (F11) clears it, and 'threshold, latch and wiring of the alert outputs: a follow-up of R6'. V283 (owner, 2026-10-01) rules a latch of the rail's own: only that converter switches off and stays off until the F11 clear. P2 lists 'Rail's own latch' among the requirements of Servo supply temperature and records the MCP9808T-E/MS failing it, but returns no function and no part for the latch itself (4 a board, one for each converter, set by that MCP9808's alert, holding that converter's EN/UVLO low, cleared by F11, off at power-up and reset). selection.json (round2) R3 already holds a latch (74LVC1G175GW,125) and a clear control (434153017835) for F11, from FU-2A; whether a copy per rail serves is not read.

V130 and the Follow-ups row for Port voltage ceiling (Research.md) name the latch: the port stays off until an operator or firmware action. P2 lists 'Latch until action' as a requirement of Port voltage ceiling and drops the two comparators that meet the trip bands for lacking it, but returns no function and no part for a latch (20 a board, one for each port, set by the ceiling comparator, cleared by an operator or firmware action). The R3 latch and clear control in selection.json (round2) are the nearest parts; their fit for 20 ports is not read.
